SELECT b.FINPROD_ID AS finprodId,
to_char(A.VALUE_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS valueDate, A.CLOSE_PRICE AS closePrice, A.AVERAGE_PRICE AS averagePrice, A.MAX_PRICE AS maxPrice, A.MIN_PRICE AS minPrice, A.BUY_ONE_PRICE AS buyOnePrice, A.SELL_ONE_PRICE AS sellOnePrice, B.FINPROD_ABBR AS fundName, C.TYPE_1 AS fundType FROM mst_FUND_MARKET_INFO A LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT B ON B.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = A.FUND_CODE LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE C ON C.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID AND B.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE 1=1
AND b.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND b.FINPROD_ID LIKE '%'|| #{fundCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ||'%'
AND A.VALUE_DATE <= to_date(#{endDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND A.VALUE_DATE >= to_date(#{startDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND C.TYPE_1 = #{fundType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND B.FINPROD_ABBR LIKE '%'|| #{fundName,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ||'%'
SELECT FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodId FROM FIN_PRODUCT FP WHERE FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND FP.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{prodtype2,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
